Row 3 is a wall except at x=11. So from (10,4) I can't go up. I need to get to (11,3) which is only reachable from (11,2) above or (11,4) below (the rock). Wait — the rock is at (11,4), and (11,3) is the gap. Let me re-read: row 3 is `###########.#` — so x=11 is walkable at y=3. Row 4 is `#..........o#` — x=11 is the rock. So (11,3) is reachable only from (11,2). And (11,2) is reachable from row 2 which connects to the left side. So the route is: go up the left side to row 2, then right along row 2 to x=11, then down to (11,3)... but the chest is at (11,1).

Let me go left and up to row 2.
